counting_note: Counts include repeated flips of a cell; transition opportunities are selected pixels times adjacent-step pairs.
observation_note: Pooled cells and cell-times are descriptive; maps are the reporting units.
population: named fixed mask intersected with changed, valid, non-source primary cells
scope: Paired correctness and continuous margin summaries on saved maps. Maps are the reporting units; cells, cell-times, checkpoints, interpolations and permutations are not independent replicates.

copy_rule: All retained scientific values round-trip exactly. Repeated metadata prose is centralized here; per-map rows use lossless column arrays.
